declared.text: Torch heat package (kT, 2026-10-25): each pellet is wrapped in a shell of remass that soaks up the burn and leaves as exhaust. The shell must let no more than ~358 ppm of the burn's energy escape as light, counting its own glow (the reactor face's 10 MW/m2 limit); the design value is 180 ppm. With the model's other assumptions (torch/torch_heat_inputs.json: light 40% of fusion energy; He3-rich, spin-polarised fuel with 0.76% neutrons, 85% absorbed by the shell; plume contact 1e-4 of charged energy; coil shield transmission 1e-3), 1.40 GW reaches hot structure and 0.48 MW the magnet coils at 12.6 TW of fusion. These are assumptions, not results. Replaces v0.5.1's 387 MW (34 ppm) torch-leak gap.
declared.as: v0.5.2 torch heat package (kT chose the package and 1,750 K fins on 2026-10-25 and accepted this wording the same day): the remass shell lets no more than ~360 ppm of the burn's energy escape as light, counting its own glow; design value 180 ppm; with the heat model's other assumptions 1.40 GW reaches hot structure and 0.48 MW the magnet coils.

declared.text: Hot fins run for life at 1750 K. Fallback: 1,500 K fins, ~49 m span, ~30 t, still inside the reserve.
